title: Native events and default behavior
description: Trace input, change and submit events and their default actions while preserving native constraints and accessible feedback.
objectives: Distinguish input from change and submit events
Observe event names without leaking private input values
Use preventDefault on a valid local form submission only
Preserve native keyboard behavior and independent button actions
rubric: I observed input and change without logging field contents.
I used the form submit event and intentionally prevented only local submission.
I verified Enter-key behavior, helper buttons and accessible feedback.
